title: Rogue AI ship placement (seeded, per-system roster)
description: Each star system has a seeded roster of rogue AI ships (pirates) patrolling its space — deterministic per system, with class distribution from the catalog, and respawn rules that keep the threat level stable.
acceptanceCriteria: src/shared/world/ai.ts: rosterFor(systemId) → 6-10 rogue ships: {aiId, classId (weighted: scout 50%, interceptor 35%, freighter 15% — freighters are cargo hauls for the player to destroy or outrun), spawnPos (seeded, 500-3000 u from the star, never within 200 u of a station), patrolCenter, patrolRadius (200-800 u)} — identical for client and server from the seed

AI ships are persistent per-system entities: their hull/damage state persists with the shard (in-memory while the shard lives; on shard reap they reset to full — documented: rogues are a renewable threat, not a persistent world state); a destroyed rogue respawns at its spawnPos after 120 s (server timer), with a 'rogue respawn' debug log

AI names: seeded from a pirate-callsign list (40 names, no duplicates within a roster, no collision with the 3-16 char callsign validation — they look like player callsigns in the presence list, marked with a small 'AI' tag in the HUD (TASK-50) so the player can tell)
AI ships appear in snapshots like player ships (same EntityState, kind 'ship', ai: true flag) — the client renders them identically (livery = a per-class default pirate scheme, seeded)
No AI on the surface in v1 (rogues are space-only; surface threats are environmental, TASK-48) — a roster never spawns inside an atmosphere radius (placement test)

Unit tests: roster determinism (same seed → same roster, 3 systems), class distribution bounds (6-10 ships, weights hold over 100 seeded samples), spacing from stations, no-atmosphere placement; integration: shard spawn loads the roster, kill one rogue, it respawns after 120 s (fake timers), shard reap resets rogues to full

steps.details: rosterFor(systemId) per spec; names from a shared list (src/shared/ai/names.ts, 40 pirate callsigns); spawn positions seeded with rejection (station proximity, atmosphere); patrol parameters seeded.

Shard spawn: create AI ship entities from the roster (full hull/shields, docked=false, state 'patrolling' — the behavior is TASK-46; this task gives them the entities + respawn timers); reap: AI state discarded (ships are re-derived on next spawn); respawn timer per destroyed rogue (120 s).

AI ships render like player ships (same mesh builder, default pirate livery); the presence list shows them with an 'AI' tag (they are in the snapshot entity list, not the presence list — the PlayerList gets an AI section from the entity list: callsigns with ai:true); targetable/lockable like players (TASK-44 works on them).
All listed; run full suite + typecheck.

technicalNotes: 6-10 rogues per system × up to 3 active shards × 16 players — the sim budget (TASK-13 benchmark) must absorb up to ~10 AI ships per shard (it does: the benchmark uses 16 ships).
AI ships are the PvE focus (PRD): they give new players something to do before PvP exists in their session.
